about: Approved regression cases for gate() on next/world.py. Each case is read as the product path reads it (turns.start_turn and the hook: join on, so d1 decides whether neighbouring sentences are one phrase); "join": true records that it was approved that way. The expected values were first read by the real d1-2b with join off on 2026-11-10 and checked by hand; on 2026-11-10 they were read again with join on and the join wording of scriptt16.JOIN, and each reads the same. Values: the say() text of the term of each phrase, "nothing" or "none" for a phrase that must read as no function, "quote" for a quote of an earlier reply. holes: the open holes of the approved reading.
